exams.name: First Division Examination (Fundamentals of Engineering)
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of fundamental engineering subjects including mathematics and basic sciences. Required for engineer-in-training certification. Board may waive by rule for applicants with substantially exceeding qualifications.
exams.jurisdiction: national or state; administered by board or contracted organization
exams.quote: The first division of the examination shall test the applicant's knowledge of appropriate fundamental engineering subjects, including mathematics and the basic sciences

exams.name: Second Division Examination (Principles and Practice of Engineering)
exams.notes: Tests ability to apply knowledge and assume responsible charge. Includes questions on state laws, board rules, and (for civil engineers) seismic and engineering surveying principles. Administered at least once per year.
exams.jurisdiction: national or state; administered by board or contracted organization
exams.quote: the second division of the examination shall test the applicant's ability to apply their knowledge and experience and to assume responsible charge in the professional practice of the branch of engineering in which the applicant is being examined

interval_years.quote: Certificates of registration as a professional engineer, and certificates of authority, shall be valid for a period of two years from the assigned date of renewal.

required.quote: the board shall administer an assessment of the certificate holder to reinforce the certificate holder's knowledge of state laws and the board's rules and regulations. available.quote: the board, upon application therefor, on its prescribed form, and the payment of the fee fixed by this chapter, may issue a certificate of registration as a professional engineer, without written examination, to any person holding a certificate of registration issued to him or her by any state or country when the applicant's qualifications meet the requirements of this chapter and rules established by the board.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a certificate of registration from another state or country, meet California's qualifications, and pay the required fee. establishment_regulation_required.quote: A current organization record form shall be filed with the board for all businesses engaged in rendering civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering services.

definition_quote.value: a person engaged in the professional practice of rendering service or creative work requiring education, training and experience in engineering sciences and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences in such professional or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning or design of public or private utilities, structures, machines, processes, circuits, buildings, equipment or projects, and supervision of construction for the purpose of securing compliance with specifications and design for any such work.
